source_priority: Nepal Post current federal assignments once separately licensed and versioned
Historical documents only within their edition namespace
Survey or administrative geometry only with separate permission and explicit postal relation
Community fallback remains non-official and independently licensed

address_display.postal: Five/seven-digit syntax is not an assignment lookup; old five-digit inputs stay ambiguous until the source edition is known.
address_display.administration: Only explicit source relations; repeated names and numeric prefixes are not joins.
address_display.house_number: Only an independently permitted explicit civic-address relation.
address_display.building: Only an independently permitted address-building relation; no nearest-building or model inference.
address_display.geometry: none until independently permitted and linked; administrative-derived polygons must never be called official postal regions.

normalization.digits: Convert homogeneous Devanagari or ASCII code strings explicitly; never number-coerce, strip arbitrary characters or pad.
normalization.labels: Preserve source spelling, script and ZWNJ; NFC/whitespace may be search aliases, never sole IDs.
normalization.headings: 84 observed hierarchy/office headings are not assignment rows; no forward fill.
normalization.ward_ranges: Validate source prefix, explicit start, upper suffix and declared count. Arithmetic total is not evidence of individually verified ward records.
normalization.time: Keep source date, publication date, PDF metadata, acquisition time and valid_from/valid_to distinct.

data_minimization.raw_bodies: Temporary local inspection only, deleted after verified GitHub push; no source rows in AGID Git.
